title: Edge case — embed with no transcript and no title
description: Verifies the Video widget renders correctly when only `kind` and `src` are provided — no transcript, no title, no startAt. The minimum viable embed.

data.markdown: All transcript / title / autoplay / startAt fields on the Video widget are optional. Only `kind` (`youtube` | `mp4`) and `src` are required. With nothing else set, the widget should render only the player, no transcript panel, no title bar.
